activationNote: Content & Diagnostic Evidence Foundation pass (post-D1). This turns an incorrect free-text guess (uninterpretable — could be any typo, unit-format miss, or arithmetic slip) into a choice among a small number of named, distinguishable error paths, without adding any new evaluator, schema, or runtime mechanism.
